## LV Enrichment — LOCAL (headless-executable)
Same Wave-A/M3 JS as the Cloud template, inlined into Code nodes.

**Mocked for local run:** trigger -> Emit Sample Identities; HubSpot search -> canned records; provider waterfall -> fixture shapes; HubSpot create/update -> Decide Action dry-run echo (NO real writes).

**REAL:** enrichmentGate, normalizeProviders, scoreEnrichment (best-per-field w/ provenance), mergeContacts (non-clobber).

Three identities exercise every gate branch: **create / enrich / skip**.
